parent_objective: implement selector-only history-vs-control active-set classification over M1585 rows
blocked_by: M1587 design has not yet been implemented
supersedes: another source-diverse intervention implementation before selector audit

public_gates: M1588 must classify M1585 directed pairs into clean dominated null and invalid labels
M1588 must not rerun simulator or interventions
M1588 must report source-edge and source-family diversity of clean rows
M1588 must report whether clean count is sufficient or a source-generation repair is needed
M1588 must keep materialization training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run implementation smoke that reruns simulator

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements selector-only clean/dominated/null classification after M1587 design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: selector-only public diagnostic implementation; no simulator rerun, history interventions, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop after selector implementation and route to audit
stop if implementation reruns simulator or interventions
stop if implementation exports training corpus
stop if implementation treats clean rows as enough for materialization
fallback_plan: route to audit whether clean count passes or fails
if clean surface is too small, audit source-generation repair
if clean surface is source-singleton, audit source diversity repair

admission_evidence: M1587 pre-registers clean, dominated, null, and invalid labels
allowed_updates: selector implementation module and focused tests
M1588 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: classified directed pair rows are written

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1588 is selector-only over M1585 control diagnostics; it cannot strengthen the self-ID claim.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If clean rows remain below target, record it and route to audit instead of weakening standards.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A selector-only classifier can make M1585's clean history-vs-control sub-surface explicit and decide whether source-generation repair is needed.
success_criteria: focused tests cover clean/dominated/null labels and summary gates
classified and clean row artifacts exist
no simulator rerun or history intervention is executed
training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export materialization and self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: implementation reruns simulator or history interventions
implementation changes actor inputs or uses private holdout
implementation exports a training corpus or starts training/PPO
decision_rule: M1588 passes as selector implementation if it classifies existing rows with clean guardrails and routes to audit before any repair, materialization, or training.
